\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 225-228 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:TA-R233-first-pass-words-from-chapters-225-228}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for the day before yesterday and a second.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to taste, to fill, to fold, to take off, to change
  \item to begin, to touch, to sneeze, to swallow, to chew
  \item to correct, to enquire, to register, to book in advance, to apply
  \item to type, to translate, to cancel, to hurry, to love
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To taste? (\textbf{\ta{சுவை} \ta{பார்}}, \emph{cuvai pār}.) To fill? (\textbf{\ta{நிரப்பு}}, \emph{nirappu}.) To fold? (\textbf{\ta{மடி}}, \emph{maṭi}.) To take off? (\textbf{\ta{கழற்று}}, \emph{kaḻaṟṟu}.) To change? (\textbf{\ta{மாற்று}}, \emph{māṟṟu}.) To begin? (\textbf{\ta{ஆரம்பி}}, \emph{ārampi}.) To touch? (\textbf{\ta{தொடு}}, \emph{toṭu}.) To sneeze? (\textbf{\ta{தும்மு}}, \emph{tummu}.) To swallow? (\textbf{\ta{விழுங்கு}}, \emph{viḻuṅku}.) To chew? (\textbf{\ta{மெல்}}, \emph{mel}.) To correct? (\textbf{\ta{திருத்து}}, \emph{tiruttu}.) To enquire? (\textbf{\ta{விசாரி}}, \emph{vicāri}.) To register? (\textbf{\ta{பதிவு} \ta{செய்}}, \emph{pativu cey}.) To book in advance? (\textbf{\ta{முன்பதிவு} \ta{செய்}}, \emph{muṉpativu cey}.) To apply? (\textbf{\ta{விண்ணப்பி}}, \emph{viṇṇappi}.) To type? (\textbf{\ta{தட்டச்சு} \ta{செய்}}, \emph{taṭṭaccu cey}.) To translate? (\textbf{\ta{மொழிபெயர்}}, \emph{moḻipeyar}.) To cancel? (\textbf{\ta{ரத்து} \ta{செய்}}, \emph{rattu cey}.) To hurry? (\textbf{\ta{அவசரப்படு}}, \emph{avacarappaṭu}.) To love? (\textbf{\ta{நேசி}}, \emph{nēci}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 229-233 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:TA-R233-second-pass-words-from-chapters-229-233}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for to praise and to scold.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to praise, to scold, to dream, to separate, to throw
  \item to imagine, to doubt, to complain, to download, to upload
  \item to faint, to wilt, to warn, to beg, to manage
  \item a toothache, a wound, a tablet, a patient, a nurse
  \item every year, dawn, the day after tomorrow, the day before yesterday, a second
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To praise? (\textbf{\ta{பாராட்டு}}, \emph{pārāṭṭu}.) To scold? (\textbf{\ta{திட்டு}}, \emph{tiṭṭu}.) To dream? (\textbf{\ta{கனவு} \ta{காண்}}, \emph{kaṉavu kāṇ}.) To separate? (\textbf{\ta{பிரி}}, \emph{piri}.) To throw? (\textbf{\ta{வீசு}}, \emph{vīcu}.) To imagine? (\textbf{\ta{கற்பனை} \ta{செய்}}, \emph{kaṟpaṉai cey}.) To doubt? (\textbf{\ta{சந்தேகப்படு}}, \emph{cantēkappaṭu}.) To complain? (\textbf{\ta{குறை} \ta{சொல்}}, \emph{kuṟai col}.) To download? (\textbf{\ta{பதிவிறக்கு}}, \emph{pativiṟakku}.) To upload? (\textbf{\ta{பதிவேற்று}}, \emph{pativēṟṟu}.) To faint? (\textbf{\ta{மயங்கு}}, \emph{mayaṅku}.) To wilt? (\textbf{\ta{வாடு}}, \emph{vāṭu}.) To warn? (\textbf{\ta{எச்சரி}}, \emph{eccari}.) To beg? (\textbf{\ta{கெஞ்சு}}, \emph{keñcu}.) To manage? (\textbf{\ta{சமாளி}}, \emph{camāḷi}.) A toothache? (\textbf{\ta{பல்வலி}}, \emph{palvali}.) A wound? (\textbf{\ta{காயம்}}, \emph{kāyam}.) A tablet? (\textbf{\ta{மாத்திரை}}, \emph{māttirai}.) A patient? (\textbf{\ta{நோயாளி}}, \emph{nōyāḷi}.) A nurse? (\textbf{\ta{செவிலியர்}}, \emph{ceviliyar}.) Every year? (\textbf{\ta{ஆண்டுதோறும்}}, \emph{āṇṭutōṟum}.) Dawn? (\textbf{\ta{விடியல்}}, \emph{viṭiyal}.) The day after tomorrow? (\textbf{\ta{நாளை} \ta{மறுநாள்}}, \emph{nāḷai maṟunāḷ}.) The day before yesterday? (\textbf{\ta{நேற்று} \ta{முன்தினம்}}, \emph{nēṟṟu muṉtiṉam}.) A second? (\textbf{\ta{விநாடி}}, \emph{vināṭi}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
